skill.name: html-slides
skill.description: Create browser-based reveal.js presentations with slide navigation, themes, animated fragments, code highlighting, and speaker notes.
skill.summary: Turn presentation outlines into customizable reveal.js HTML slide decks.
skill.author: claude-office-skills

security_audit.summary: The 23 shell-execution matches are Markdown formatting, and three resource links are benign references. Eleven CDN asset references present low-severity supply-chain exposure through mutable version aliases without integrity checks. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential access, or intentional data exfiltration.

remediation.issue: CDN examples use mutable reveal.js@4 URLs without integrity checks for scripts and stylesheets.
remediation.suggestion: Pin an exact release and add verified integrity hashes with crossorigin attributes, or distribute reviewed assets locally.

content.value_statement: Building interactive browser presentations requires slide structure, styling, and framework configuration. This skill provides reveal.js examples for turning an outline into a customizable HTML deck.
actual_capabilities: Generate reveal.js HTML decks with horizontal slides and nested vertical sections.
Apply built-in themes, slide transitions, fragment animations, and automatic animation attributes.
Structure code walkthrough slides with syntax highlighting and selected line emphasis.
Add speaker note markup and configure presentation plugins.
Configure navigation controls, slide numbers, timing, dimensions, and scaling.
Define slide backgrounds using colors, images, videos, or gradients.
limitations: The skill contains documentation and examples, not an executable generator or automated browser tests.
CDN-based examples require network access unless framework assets are provided locally.
Markdown slides and speaker views require plugin scripts that the basic examples do not load.
Metadata mentions PowerPoint conversion, but no conversion implementation or workflow is supplied.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Technical Talk
use_cases.description: Build a code-focused deck with highlighted examples, nested explanations, and presenter notes.

use_cases.title: Present a Product Launch
use_cases.description: Turn product messaging into browser slides with staged reveals, metrics, and animated transitions.

use_cases.title: Create a Training Session
use_cases.description: Organize lessons into horizontal topics and vertical detail slides with notes and configurable navigation.

prompt_templates.title: Build a First Deck
prompt_templates.prompt: Create five reveal.js slides about [topic] for [audience]. Use the white theme, simple navigation, and one main idea per slide.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: create a basic presentation from a topic.

prompt_templates.title: Customize an Outline
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn [outline] into a reveal.js deck with vertical detail slides, fade transitions, staged bullet reveals, and speaker notes. Load the notes plugin.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: add structure and presentation features.

prompt_templates.title: Explain Code
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a reveal.js walkthrough of [code]. Add syntax highlighting, selected line emphasis, vertical explanation slides, and presenter notes. Include the required plugin scripts.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an Offline Deck
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a reveal.js deck from [brief] using reviewed local framework assets. Include Markdown, highlighting, and notes plugins, responsive scaling, and no external asset requests.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: specify dependencies and offline delivery constraints.

output_examples.input: Create an API design talk with a nested resource naming section and highlighted request examples.
output: Agenda slide with sequential topic reveals.
REST principles section with a vertical resource naming slide and highlighted HTTP examples.

output_examples.input: Make a product launch deck with problem metrics and an animated solution reveal.
output: Product introduction slide using a light theme.
Problem slide with a staged metric reveal.
Two solution slides with matching animation identifiers for a continuous visual transition.

best_practices: Provide the audience, outline, presentation length, and preferred theme before generating slides.
Load each required plugin explicitly and test navigation, notes, highlighting, and media in the target browser.
Use reviewed local dependencies for offline delivery, or pin CDN releases with verified integrity hashes.
anti_patterns: Treating metadata references to PowerPoint conversion as a supplied conversion workflow.
Assuming the CDN examples work offline or provide an immutable, integrity-verified dependency set.
Publishing sensitive speaker notes inside a deck shared with the audience.

faq.question: What does this skill produce?
faq.answer: It guides generation of reveal.js HTML presentations with slide structure, styling, and JavaScript configuration.

faq.question: Can the presentations run offline?
faq.answer: Yes, when reveal.js, plugins, and media are available locally. The supplied CDN examples require network access.

faq.question: Does it convert PowerPoint files?
faq.answer: No conversion workflow is supplied. Metadata names an external conversion tool, but this skill only provides HTML presentation guidance.

faq.question: Are speaker notes supported?
faq.answer: The skill demonstrates note markup and plugin configuration. Load the notes plugin to enable the speaker view.

faq.question: Can it display code and Markdown slides?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides markup examples for both, but the corresponding plugin scripts must be loaded and registered.

faq.question: Are the CDN examples integrity protected?
faq.answer: No. They use mutable reveal.js@4 URLs without integrity hashes. Use pinned, integrity-verified releases or reviewed local assets.
